mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_issue_attachment ( issue_id, stage, file_url, file_name, file_type, sort_no, created_by, created_name ) VALUES ( #{issueId}, #{stage}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{sortNo}, #{createdBy}, #{createdName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_issue_attachment SET issue_id = #{issueId}, stage = #{stage}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, created_by = #{createdBy}, created_name = #{createdName} WHERE id = #{attachmentId} AND (issue_id IS NULL OR issue_id = #{issueId})
